journeyTemplate.name: Emergency Fund Setup
journeyTemplate.purpose: New user → personalised EF target with attribution → 3-layer liquidity allocation → monthly contribution plan with milestones. The 8 sizing dimensions seed the user profile for all future features.
journeyTemplate.advisoryConstraint: Recommend instrument TYPES (savings account, liquid fund, short-term FD) — NEVER name specific banks, funds, or products.

phase.purpose: The Companion's territory. The Planner's plan covers subsequent phases.
phase.proRole: NONE — the Companion handles Discovery conversationally.

phase.purpose: Capture 8 sizing dimensions through adaptive conversation. Deliver value-after insights at cluster boundaries.
phase.proRole: Plan dimension capture sequence, group related dimensions, schedule value-after moments.
phase.keyMechanic: Building Your Picture progress indicator — 8 pills filling with running target estimate.

phase.purpose: Reveal personalised EF target with full attribution.
phase.proRole: Plan target computation, attribution display, D3 social obligation prompt (OPTIONAL), Starter Shield trigger.
phase.keyComponents: Target Card, Attribution Strip, D3 Prompt Card, Starter Shield overlay

phase.layers: Instant Access (savings account) / Quick Access (liquid fund) / Stable Reserve (short-term FD)

phase.purpose: Propose monthly contribution plan with milestone timeline.
phase.proRole: Plan contribution calculation, milestone projection, action card, exit experience.
phase.keyComponents: Contribution Plan Card, Milestone Rows, Action Card, Salary-Day Reminder, Exit Message

dimension.name: Income Stability
dimension.what: Employment type + employer stability / income pattern
dimension.impact: Govt/PSU → 3-4mo. Large private → 4-6mo. Startup → 6-8mo. Freelancer → 8-12mo. Gig → 6-10mo.
dimension.followUps: If salaried → employer type. If business → tenure.

dimension.name: Dependency Load
dimension.what: Who depends on user's income — nature matters, not just count
dimension.impact: Aging parents with no insurance ≠ working adult sibling.
dimension.followUps: Aging parents → health insurance. Children → age bracket.

dimension.name: Insurance Coverage Quality
dimension.what: Health insurance level; term insurance flag
dimension.impact: Adequate health (₹10L+) + term → reduce 1-2mo. No health insurance → add ₹2-5L buffer.

dimension.name: Fixed Obligations
dimension.what: Rent/EMI, school fees, premiums — as ₹ or % of income

dimension.name: Household Income Sources
dimension.impact: Dual-income salaried = lowest risk. Single + variable = highest risk.

dimension.name: Health Profile
dimension.privacyNote: "Prefer not to say" is always valid → use conservative estimate. The Companion offers text-input fallback and does not echo verbally.

dimension.name: Open / Contextual
dimension.mechanic: Not a structured question. A 9th BYP pill appears dynamically.
dimension.examples: Supporting brother's education, pending legal case

cluster.name: Income Profile
cluster.valueAfter: First range estimate. "Based on your income profile, your baseline is X-Y months."

cluster.name: Responsibility
cluster.valueAfter: "Safety Net So Far" card showing each factor's impact.

pattern.description: Categorical inputs. Auto-proceeds. No tap needed.
Numeric inputs. Flow pauses until confirmed.
Phase-gate. All data shown as scannable rows. Two CTAs: Looks right / Let me adjust.
User-initiated edit of a prior answer.

scenario.name: Has Existing Savings
scenario.behavior: Assessment in health-check framing. Respect existing effort.

scenario.name: Has Known Target
scenario.behavior: Offer validation, then skip to FUND_ARCHITECTURE with user's number.

scenario.name: Returning Mid-Flow
scenario.behavior: Resume from last step. If >30 days, re-verify.

journeyGuardrails.guardrail: Conservative defaults for withheld data. If a dimension is skipped, use the higher (more conservative) estimate.
D3 social obligation buffer is OPTIONAL. Never mandatory.
Starter Shield fires DETERMINISTICALLY when target ≤ existing savings. This is a backend rule, not a Planner judgment call.

field.name: openContextFactor
field.note: For D9 — define dynamically based on what user volunteers (e.g., brotherEducationCost)
